about.heading:
Your End-to-End
Logistics Solution
body: We are a Tanzanian logistics and supply company with experience moving goods across Tanzania and the East African region.
From sea freight and customs clearance to last-mile delivery and government supply, we offer complete supply chain solutions for businesses, NGOs, and public institutions.

items.title: Sea Freight
items.body: Full and shared container shipments from major global ports to Dar es Salaam, Tanga, and Mtwara.

items.title: Road Freight & Haulage
items.body: Reliable trucking for bulk goods, construction materials, and general cargo across Tanzania.

items.title: Customs Clearance
items.body: Fast, compliant TRA customs clearance at all major Tanzanian ports and border crossings.

items.title: Government & NGO Supply
items.body: Supply of office equipment, furniture, consumables, and general goods to institutions and projects.

items.title: Warehousing & Storage
items.body: Secure warehousing in Dar es Salaam with inventory tracking and goods management.

items.title: Last-Mile Distribution
items.body: Nationwide distribution reaching all regions with dedicated vehicles and local agents.

items.title: Licensed & Compliant
items.body: Fully licensed clearing and forwarding agent with all required government registrations.

items.title: Fast Clearance
items.body: Most customs clearances processed within 24–48 hours of vessel arrival.

items.title: Regional Network
items.body: Partnerships with freight agents across East Africa for seamless regional shipping.

items.title: Dedicated Account Team
items.body: Each client gets a dedicated account officer who manages all shipments end-to-end.

items.title: Cargo Insurance
items.body: All consignments covered with comprehensive marine and inland transit insurance.

items.title: 24/7 Support
items.body: Our operations team is available around the clock for urgent clearance and delivery.
